subject: Gate results for the two follow-on arms: estimator fix on top of the winner, and the next dose step
METHODOLOGICAL_GAP_OWNED_UP_FRONT: Arms D and E were pushed WITHOUT a predeclared gate. The predeclared file gate-predeclared-2026-08-21-context-window.json covers the context-window arm, the upscale arm and a standalone estimator arm, but not these two, which were built and pushed within minutes of arm A's result. That is the same class of error as calibrating a gate against the wrong control. It is recorded rather than papered over, and the conservative rule applied below is: a TIE is not a promotion, and the paired sign test against the incumbent is the deciding evidence, not the level total.

q38-ctxwin-imgtok-v1.verdict: NO PROMOTION. Ship the simpler config.
q38-ctxwin-imgtok-v1.change: image token estimator fix on top of the winning context-window arm
q38-ctxwin-imgtok-v1.reading: No evidence of improvement over the incumbent on any axis. Levels tie, mean is lower, actions rise 49% (1,979 to 2,953) for the same completions, so per-level efficiency falls, and peak KV rises to 69.5% because correcting the image charge packs more REAL content into the same nominal budget. The estimator fix is still a genuine correctness fix; it simply does not pay once the window is already raised, because the window raise has ALREADY bought the history the fix would have freed.
q38-ctxwin-imgtok-v1.keep_it_for: The upscale-16 retest. That is the case where it matters most: it drops the upscale-16 image charge from 3,891 to 1,039 estimated tokens. Do not ship it on its own.

q38-ctxwin-65536-v1.reading: The dose-response turns over. This is the most valuable thing the two follow-on arms bought: we now know 49,152 is near an optimum rather than merely better than the shipped 32,768. Generation throughput falls to 349.9 tok/s (a 34% drop from the control) and peak KV reaches 76.0%, right at the highest value we had ever run.

31744.note: shipped config, scored 1.71 on the board

64512.note: turns over; p = 0.133 against control, not significant

dose_response_on_the_analyzer_history_bu.interpretation: Three points, one run each, on an instrument whose byte-identical rerun has differed by 6 levels. The PEAK location is weakly identified; what the curve does establish is that 'more context is always better' is false, so do not push the window further without new evidence.

decision.why: It is the only arm with a significant paired result against the control (p = 0.029), it has the best mean of any arm, and neither follow-on beat it. Choosing it over arm D is also the simpler artifact: one fewer source overlay for no measured loss.
decision.rollback: vineethsaivs/arc3-q38-combined-v2-ordinary-commit v1, the config that actually scored 1.71
